verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that Claude loads skills automatically when relevant, based on a frontmatter description that should state what the skill does and when to use it. It also ships a skill-creator that optimizes descriptions for triggering accuracy. However, multiple hands-on community reports say skills often fail to trigger even with proper YAML descriptions or keyword cues, and some users get better results by pasting the instructions into AGENTS.md. Missing for 10: independent evidence that auto-triggering works reliably, and documented triggering-accuracy metrics or guarantees.
